```{r Load, clean and organize data}
library(tidyverse)
library(HaibLocalTools)

# read in SMILES data
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder,"01.features"))
# read in the actual aldyhydes data
aldy_df <- read_excel("Input_data_process.xlsx", sheet = "1.Aldyhydes.Result_feature")
names <- aldy_df$CID
aldy_df <- aldy_df %>%    
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(-Serial_number, -Name, -PC_SMILES, -CID, -Formula, -Canonical_SMILES)
rownames(aldy_df) <- names
# read in the actual polyamines data
polya_df <- read_excel("Input_data_process.xlsx", sheet = "2.Polyamines.Result_feature")
names <- polya_df$CID
polya_df <- polya_df %>%    
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(-Serial_number, -Name, -PC_SMILES, -CID, -Formula, -Canonical_SMILES)
rownames(polya_df) <- names
# read in MIC file
library(readxl)
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "01.features"))
mic_df <- read_excel("Input_data_process.xlsx", sheet = "3.MIC_data")

# At this point, the row index of mic_df is aldehyde CID, and the column name is polyamine CID.
# Remove columns containing missing values from both the aldy and polya features.
# Create a function to check for NA values of all types.
fxx.check_all_na <- function(x) {any(is.na(x) | is.infinite(x) | is.nan(x))}

aldy_df_clean <- aldy_df %>%
    select_if(~!fxx.check_all_na(.))
polya_df_clean <- polya_df %>% 
    select_if(~!fxx.check_all_na(.))

# Create an empty list to store the features and target values.
samples <- list()
targets <- numeric()
mic_df_backup <- mic_df
names <- mic_df$CID
mic_df <- mic_df %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(-CID)
rownames(mic_df) <- names

# Iterate through each combination of aldehydes (rows) and polyamines (columns) in mic_df
for(aldy_cid in rownames(mic_df)) {
    # Check if the aldehyde is present in the cleaned aldy feature data.
    if(!(aldy_cid %in% rownames(aldy_df_clean))) next
    
    for(polya_cid in colnames(mic_df)) {
        # Check if the polyamine is present in the cleaned polyamine characteristic data.
        if(!(polya_cid %in% rownames(polya_df_clean))) next
        mic_value <- mic_df[aldy_cid, polya_cid] 
        if(is.na(mic_value)) next 
        
        aldy_feat <- as.numeric(aldy_df_clean[aldy_cid,])
        polya_feat <- as.numeric(polya_df_clean[polya_cid,])
        sample_feat <- c(aldy_feat, polya_feat) 
        # Add to results list
        samples[[length(samples) + 1]] <- sample_feat
        targets <- c(targets, mic_value)
    }
}
# Convert the samples list to matrix form, with each row representing one sample.
samples_matrix <- do.call(rbind, samples)

# Create empty dataframe to store the combined features and metadata
combined_df <- data.frame()
# Iterate through each aldehyde (row) and polyamine (column) combination in mic_df
for(aldy_cid in rownames(mic_df)) {
  # Check if the aldehyde exists in the cleaned aldehyde features data
  if(!(aldy_cid %in% rownames(aldy_df_clean))) next
  
  for(polya_cid in colnames(mic_df)) {
    # Check if the polyamine exists in the cleaned polyamine features data
    if(!(polya_cid %in% rownames(polya_df_clean))) next
    mic_value <- mic_df[aldy_cid, polya_cid] # Extract MIC value
    if(is.na(mic_value)) next # Skip if MIC value is missing
    
    # Get corresponding features
    aldy_feat <- as.numeric(aldy_df_clean[aldy_cid,])
    polya_feat <- as.numeric(polya_df_clean[polya_cid,])
    
    # Create a new row with metadata and features
    row_data <- data.frame(
      aldy_CID = aldy_cid,
      polya_CID = polya_cid,
      MIC = mic_value
    )
    r_aldy_df_clean <- as.data.frame(aldy_df_clean[aldy_cid,]) %>%
        setNames(., paste0("aldy_", colnames(.)))
    r_polya_df_clean <- as.data.frame(polya_df_clean[polya_cid,]) %>%
        setNames(., paste0("polya_", colnames(.)))
    r_row_data <- cbind(row_data, r_aldy_df_clean, r_polya_df_clean)
    # Append to the combined dataframe
    combined_df <- rbind(combined_df, r_row_data)
  }
}

# Add labels based on MIC values
combined_df$labels <- cut(combined_df$MIC, 
                         breaks = c(-Inf, 0.5, 1, 2, Inf),
                         labels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
                         right = FALSE)
# Convert labels to numeric
combined_df$labels <- as.numeric(as.character(combined_df$labels))
combined_df  <- combined_df %>% 
    dplyr::select(labels, everything())
names <- paste0(combined_df$aldy_CID, "_", combined_df$polya_CID)
rownames(combined_df) <- names


out_dir <- "02.train_model"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
```

```{r Model variables selection by LASSO regression}
# lasso 
library(glmnet)
lassodata = x
lassodata = as.data.frame(lapply(lassodata, function(x) {
  if(is.factor(x)) {
    as.numeric(x)
  } else {
    x
  }
}))



set.seed(11)
lassox=as.matrix(lassodata[,c(2:ncol(lassodata))])
lassoy=data.matrix(lassodata[,1])
fit = glmnet(lassox, lassoy, family="multinomial",
              alpha=1)    
fit = glmnet(lassox, lassoy, family="multinomial", intercept = F, alpha=1) 
pdf("lasso.pdf",5,5)
plot(fit,xvar = "lambda", label = F,lwd=2)
dev.off()

lasso.cv = cv.glmnet(x=lassox, y=lassoy, family="multinomial", nfold=10,
                      intercept = F, alpha=1)
pdf("lasso.cv.pdf",5,5)
plot(lasso.cv,lwd=2) 
abline(v=log(c(lasso.cv$lambda.min,lasso.cv$lambda.1se)), lty="dashed",lwd=2)
dev.off()

best_lambda <- lasso.cv$lambda.min
best_lambda
best_model <- glmnet(lassox, lassoy, alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda)
coef=coef(best_model)
index <- which(coef != 0)
actCoef <- coef[index]

lassovar=row.names(coef)[index]
lassocoef=data.frame(var=lassovar,coef=actCoef)
write.csv(lassocoef,"lasso_ceof.csv",row.names = F)
lassovar=lassovar[-1]
lassovar

# 1. First, detect and remove columns with zero variance.
# Compute the variance of each column.
var_zero <- apply(lassox, 2, function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
print(colnames(lassox)[var_zero])

lassox_filtered <- lassox[, !var_zero]
cat("\nRemain", ncol(lassox_filtered), "vriables.\n")

# 2. Normalize the filtered data.
lassox_scaled <- scale(lassox_filtered)

# 3. Fit the full model path for plotting.
fit = glmnet(lassox_scaled, lassoy, 
             family="multinomial", 
             alpha=1)

pdf("lasso.pdf", 5, 5)
plot(fit, xvar = "lambda", label = F, lwd=2)
dev.off()

# 4. Run cross-validation.
set.seed(11)
lasso.cv = cv.glmnet(x=lassox_scaled, 
                     y=lassoy, 
                     family="multinomial",
                     nfold=10,
                     alpha=1,
                     nlambda=100,
                     lambda.min.ratio=1e-6)

pdf("lasso.cv.pdf", 5, 5)
plot(lasso.cv, lwd=2)
abline(v=log(c(lasso.cv$lambda.min, lasso.cv$lambda.1se)), 
       lty="dashed", lwd=2)
dev.off()

best_lambda <- lasso.cv$lambda.min
print(paste("Best lambda:", best_lambda))

best_model <- glmnet(lassox_scaled, lassoy, 
                     alpha=1, 
                     lambda=best_lambda,
                     family="multinomial")

coef_list <- coef(best_model)

selected_vars <- c()
for(i in 1:length(coef_list)) {
    coef_matrix <- as.matrix(coef_list[[i]])
    nonzero_vars <- rownames(coef_matrix)[abs(coef_matrix) > 1e-6]
    selected_vars <- union(selected_vars, nonzero_vars)
}
selected_vars <- selected_vars[selected_vars != "(Intercept)"]
selected_vars <- selected_vars[selected_vars != ""]  
 selected_vars

if(length(selected_vars) > 0) {
    # The names of the selected variables need to be mapped back to the original feature names.
    original_names <- colnames(lassox_filtered)[match(selected_vars, colnames(lassox_filtered))]
    lassovar <- original_names
    
    # Obtain the coefficients for all categories.
    all_coefs <- matrix(0, nrow=length(selected_vars), ncol=length(coef_list))
    for(i in 1:length(coef_list)) {
        coef_matrix <- as.matrix(coef_list[[i]])
        all_coefs[, i] <- abs(coef_matrix[selected_vars, ])
    }
    
    # Compute the mean absolute coefficient for each variable.
    mean_coefs <- rowMeans(all_coefs)
    
    # merge into a data frame
    lassocoef <- data.frame(
        var = original_names,
        coef = mean_coefs
    )
   
    lassocoef <- lassocoef[order(-abs(lassocoef$coef)), ]
    write.csv(lassocoef, "lasso_coef.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}

var = c("labels", lassovar)

dev <- traindata
vad <- testdata

dev=dev[,var]
```

```{r Multi-Logistic Regression}
#=================================== MultiLogistic Regression ===================================#
dev$labels <- factor(dev$labels, 
                    levels = 1:4, 
                    labels = paste0("Class", 1:4))
vad$labels <- factor(vad$labels, 
                    levels = 1:4, 
                    labels = paste0("Class", 1:4))  


# 2. Set cross-validation control parameters.
set.seed(11)
train.control <- trainControl(
    method = 'repeatedcv',
    number = 10,            
    repeats = 3,           
    classProbs = TRUE,     
    savePredictions = "all",  
    summaryFunction = multiClassSummary  
)

library(nnet)  
set.seed(11)
multinom_model <- train(labels ~ .,
                       data = dev,
                       method = "multinom",  
                       metric = "Accuracy",
                       trControl = train.control,
                       trace = FALSE)  
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "03.train_model", seed,"11.model_multilog"))
saveRDS(multinom_model, "multinom_model.rds")
# 4. Extract the detailed results from each cross-validation fold.
cv_results <- multinom_model$pred %>%
    group_by(Resample) %>%
    summarise(
        Accuracy = mean(pred == obs),
        
        .groups = 'drop'
    )

# Compute detailed metrics for each category.
for(class_level in levels(dev$labels)) {
    temp_results <- multinom_model$pred %>%
        group_by(Resample) %>%
        summarise(
            # Treat the current class as the positive class and compute the metrics.
            TP = sum(pred == class_level & obs == class_level),
            FP = sum(pred == class_level & obs != class_level),
            TN = sum(pred != class_level & obs != class_level),
            FN = sum(pred != class_level & obs == class_level),
            
            Precision = TP / (TP + FP),
            Recall = TP / (TP + FN),
            F1 = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall),
            
            .groups = 'drop'
        )
    
    # Add category prefixes to the column names.
    names(temp_results)[-1] <- paste0(class_level, "_", names(temp_results)[-1])
    cv_results <- merge(cv_results, temp_results, by = "Resample")
}

summary_stats <- cv_results %>%
    summarise(across(-Resample, 
                    list(Mean = mean,
                         SD = sd,
                         Min = min,
                         Max = max,
                         Median = median)))


library(openxlsx)
wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "CV_Results")
writeData(wb, "CV_Results", cv_results)

addWorksheet(wb, "Summary_Statistics")
writeData(wb, "Summary_Statistics", summary_stats)

addWorksheet(wb, "Model_Info")
model_info <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c("Model_Type", "Best_Accuracy"),
    Value = c("Multinomial Logistic Regression", 
              toString(max(multinom_model$results$Accuracy)))
)
writeData(wb, "Model_Info", model_info)

conf_mat <- confusionMatrix(multinom_model$pred$pred, multinom_model$pred$obs)
addWorksheet(wb, "Confusion_Matrix")
writeData(wb, "Confusion_Matrix", as.data.frame(conf_mat$table))

saveWorkbook(wb, "multinom_cv_performance.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)


library(ggplot2)

pdf("cv_accuracy_boxplot.pdf", width = 2, height = 4)
ggplot(cv_results, aes(y = Accuracy)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Accuracy Distribution Across CV Folds",
         y = "Accuracy") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
dev.off()

pdf("cv_f1_by_class_boxplot.pdf", width = 5, height = 6)
cv_results %>%
    select(matches("_F1$")) %>%
    gather(key = "Class", value = "F1") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Class, y = F1)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgreen") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "F1-Score Distribution by Class",
         y = "F1-Score",
         x = "Class") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
dev.off()

var_imp <- varImp(multinom_model)
print(var_imp)
```

```{r SVM model}
# support vector machine
set.seed(11)
svm_model <- train(labels ~ .,
                   data = dev,
                   method = 'svmLinear',
                   metric = 'Accuracy', 
                   trControl = train.control)

cv_results_svm <- svm_model$pred %>%
    group_by(Resample) %>%
    summarise(
        Accuracy = mean(pred == obs),
        .groups = 'drop'
    )

for(class_level in levels(dev$labels)) {
    temp_results <- svm_model$pred %>%
        group_by(Resample) %>%
        summarise(
            
            TP = sum(pred == class_level & obs == class_level),
            FP = sum(pred == class_level & obs != class_level),
            TN = sum(pred != class_level & obs != class_level),
            FN = sum(pred != class_level & obs == class_level),
            
            Precision = TP / (TP + FP),
            Recall = TP / (TP + FN),
            F1 = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall),
            
            .groups = 'drop'
        )
    
    names(temp_results)[-1] <- paste0(class_level, "_", names(temp_results)[-1])
    
    cv_results_svm <- merge(cv_results_svm, temp_results, by = "Resample")
}

summary_stats_svm <- cv_results_svm %>%
    summarise(across(-Resample, 
                    list(Mean = mean,
                         SD = sd,
```

```{r GBM model}
}
```

```{r Random forest}
          legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
    labs(x = "Importance Scores", y = "Features", title = "Random Forest")
dev.off()

pdf("rf_roc_curves.pdf", 8, 6)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  

for(i in 1:4) {
    class_name <- paste0("Class", i)
    prob_col <- paste0("Class", i)
    roc_obj <- roc(rf_model$pred$obs == class_name, rf_model$pred[, prob_col])
    plot(roc_obj, main = paste("ROC Curve for", class_name),

    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "RF: Accuracy Distribution Across CV Folds",
         y = "Accuracy") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
dev.off()

saveRDS(rf_model, "rf_model.rds")

cat("\n=== Random Forest Classification Report ===\n")
print(conf_mat_rf)
cat("\n=== Variable Importance Top 10 ===\n")
print(head(rf_important[order(-rf_important$Overall), ], 10))


cv_results_detailed <- rf_model$pred %>%
    group_by(Resample) %>%
    summarise(
        Accuracy = mean(pred == obs),
        .groups = 'drop'
    )


for(class_level in levels(rf_model$pred$obs)) {
    temp_results <- rf_model$pred %>%
        group_by(Resample) %>%
        summarise(
            TP = sum(pred == class_level & obs == class_level),
            FP = sum(pred == class_level & obs != class_level),
            TN = sum(pred != class_level & obs != class_level),
            FN = sum(pred != class_level & obs == class_level),
            
            Precision = TP / (TP + FP),
            Recall = TP / (TP + FN),
            F1 = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall),
            
            .groups = 'drop'
        )
    
    names(temp_results)[-1] <- paste0(class_level, "_", names(temp_results)[-1])
    cv_results_detailed <- merge(cv_results_detailed, temp_results, by = "Resample")
}

write.csv(cv_results_detailed, "rf_cv_results_detailed.csv", row.names = FALSE)


summary_stats <- cv_results_detailed %>%
    summarise(across(-Resample, 
                    list(Mean = mean,
                         SD = sd,
                         Min = min,
                         Max = max,
                         Median = median)))
write.csv(summary_stats, "rf_summary_statistics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Decision tree}
# 9.Decision tree
out_dir <- "03.train_model/11/19.model_cart"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "03.train_model/11/19.model_cart"))

set.seed(11)
cart_model <- train(labels ~ .,
                   data = dev,
                   metric = 'Accuracy', 
                   method = 'rpart',
                   trControl = train.control)

saveRDS(cart_model, "cart_model.rds")

cart_pred <- predict(cart_model, vad)
cart_prob <- predict(cart_model, vad, type = "prob")

conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(cart_pred, vad$labels)
write.csv(as.data.frame(conf_matrix$table), "confusion_matrix.csv")

class_metrics <- data.frame(
  Class = levels(vad$labels),
  Precision = diag(conf_matrix$table) / colSums(conf_matrix$table),
  Recall = diag(conf_matrix$table) / rowSums(conf_matrix$table),
  F1_Score = 2 * (diag(conf_matrix$table) / colSums(conf_matrix$table) * diag(conf_matrix$table) / rowSums(conf_matrix$table)) / 
    (diag(conf_matrix$table) / colSums(conf_matrix$table) + diag(conf_matrix$table) / rowSums(conf_matrix$table))
)
write.csv(class_metrics, "class_performance_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cart_imp <- varImp(cart_model, scale = FALSE)
cart_important <- data.frame(cart_imp$importance)
cart_important$Features <- rownames(cart_important)

cart_important <- cart_important %>%
  gather(key = "Class", value = "Importance", -Features) %>%
  group_by(Features) %>%
  summarise(Overall = mean(Importance)) %>%
  filter(Overall > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(Overall))

write.csv(cart_important, "cart_important.csv", row.names = FALSE)

g <- ggplot(cart_important %>% 
              arrange(Overall) %>%
              mutate(Features = factor(Features, levels = Features)),
       aes(x = Overall, y = Features)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = "#0073C2FF",
           size = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10,
                               face = "bold",
                               color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12,
                                face = "bold",
                                color = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(x = "Importance Score",
       y = "Features",
       title = "CART Decision Tree Variable Importance")

roc_data <- data.frame()
auc_values <- c()

for(class_name in levels(vad$labels)) {
  roc_obj <- roc(vad$labels == class_name, cart_prob[, class_name])
  auc_values[class_name] <- auc(roc_obj)
  
  temp_data <- data.frame(
    FPR = roc_obj$specificities,
    TPR = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    Class = class_name
  )
  roc_data <- rbind(roc_data, temp_data)
}

g_roc <- ggplot(roc_data, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = Class)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_x_reverse() + 
  coord_equal() +  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(x = "False Positive Rate",
       y = "True Positive Rate",
       title = "ROC Curves for CART (Multi-class)",
       color = "Class") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.75, y = 0.25,
           label = paste("AUC values:\n",
                        paste(names(auc_values), 
                              round(auc_values, 3), 
                              sep = ": ", 
                              collapse = "\n")),
           hjust = 0)

cv_results <- cart_model$results
write.csv(cv_results, "cart_cv_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

library(irr)  
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pROC)
library(caret)


cv_predictions <- cart_model$pred

cv_results_detailed <- cv_predictions %>%
  group_by(Resample) %>%
  summarise(
    Accuracy = sum(pred == obs) / n(),
    Kappa = kappa2(data.frame(pred, obs))$value,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

for(class_level in levels(cv_predictions$obs)) {
  temp_results <- cv_predictions %>%
    group_by(Resample) %>%
    summarise(
      TP = sum(pred == class_level & obs == class_level),
      FP = sum(pred == class_level & obs != class_level),
      TN = sum(pred != class_level & obs != class_level),
      FN = sum(pred != class_level & obs == class_level),
      
      Precision = TP / (TP + FP),
      Recall = TP / (TP + FN),
      F1 = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall),
      
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  names(temp_results)[-1] <- paste0(class_level, "_", names(temp_results)[-1])
  cv_results_detailed <- merge(cv_results_detailed, temp_results, by = "Resample")
}

write.csv(cv_results_detailed, "cart_cv_results_detailed.csv", row.names = FALSE)

summary_stats <- cv_results_detailed %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), 
                  list(Mean = mean,
                       SD = sd,
                       Min = min,
                       Max = max,
                       Median = median),
                  na.rm = TRUE))

write.csv(summary_stats, "cart_summary_statistics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r KNN model}
out_dir <- "03.train_model/11/17.model_knn"

knn_model <- train(labels ~ .,

knn_Imp <- varImp(knn_model, scale = FALSE)
knn_important <- data.frame(knn_Imp[["importance"]])
knn_important <- cbind(Features = rownames(knn_important), knn_important)

write.csv(knn_important, "knn_important.csv", row.names = FALSE)

conf_mat_knn <- confusionMatrix(knn_model$pred$pred, knn_model$pred$obs)
write.csv(as.data.frame(conf_mat_knn$table), "knn_confusion_matrix.csv", row.names = TRUE)

performance_metrics <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Accuracy", "Kappa", 
               paste0("Class", 1:4, "_Precision"),
               paste0("Class", 1:4, "_Recall"),
               paste0("Class", 1:4, "_F1")),
    Value = c(
        conf_mat_knn$overall["Accuracy"],
        conf_mat_knn$overall["Kappa"],
        conf_mat_knn$byClass[, "Precision"],
        conf_mat_knn$byClass[, "Recall"],
        conf_mat_knn$byClass[, "F1"]
    )
)
write.csv(performance_metrics, "knn_performance_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)

rt <- read.csv("knn_important.csv", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

for(i in 1:4) {
    class_name <- paste0("Class", i)
    pdf(paste0("knn_importance_", class_name, ".pdf"), 7, 5, family = "serif")
    g <- ggplot(rt, aes_string(x = class_name, y = paste0("reorder(Features,", class_name, ")"))) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity",
                position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
                size = 1,
                fill = "#0073C2FF") +
        theme_classic() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
              axis.text = element_text(size = 10,
                                     face = "bold", 
                                     color = "black"),
              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12,
                                        face = "bold",
                                        color = "black"),
              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12,
                                        face = "bold",
                                        color = "black"),
              legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
              legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
        labs(x = "Importance Scores", 
             y = "Features", 
             title = paste("KNN -", class_name))
    print(g)
    dev.off()
}

pdf("knn_roc_curves.pdf", 8, 6)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))  

for(i in 1:4) {
    class_name <- paste0("Class", i)
    prob_col <- paste0("Class", i)
    roc_obj <- roc(knn_model$pred$obs == class_name, knn_model$pred[, prob_col])
    plot(roc_obj, main = paste("ROC Curve for", class_name),
         col = "blue", lwd = 2)
    abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray")
    auc_val <- auc(roc_obj)
    legend("bottomright", legend = paste("AUC =", round(auc_val, 3)))
}
dev.off()

pdf("knn_cv_accuracy_boxplot.pdf", 8, 6)
cv_results_knn <- knn_model$pred %>%
    group_by(Resample) %>%
    summarise(Accuracy = mean(pred == obs))

ggplot(cv_results_knn, aes(y = Accuracy)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "KNN: Accuracy Distribution Across CV Folds",
         y = "Accuracy") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
dev.off()

saveRDS(knn_model, "knn_model.rds")


cv_results_detailed <- knn_model$pred %>%
    group_by(Resample) %>%
    summarise(
        Accuracy = mean(pred == obs),
        .groups = 'drop'
    )


for(class_level in levels(knn_model$pred$obs)) {
    temp_results <- knn_model$pred %>%
        group_by(Resample) %>%
        summarise(
            TP = sum(pred == class_level & obs == class_level),
            FP = sum(pred == class_level & obs != class_level),
            TN = sum(pred != class_level & obs != class_level),
            FN = sum(pred != class_level & obs == class_level),
            
            Precision = TP / (TP + FP),
            Recall = TP / (TP + FN),
            F1 = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall),
            
            .groups = 'drop'
        )
    
    names(temp_results)[-1] <- paste0(class_level, "_", names(temp_results)[-1])
    cv_results_detailed <- merge(cv_results_detailed, temp_results, by = "Resample")
}

write.csv(cv_results_detailed, "knn_cv_results_detailed.csv", row.names = FALSE)

summary_stats <- cv_results_detailed %>%
    summarise(across(-Resample, 
                    list(Mean = mean,
                         SD = sd,
                         Min = min,
                         Max = max,
                         Median = median)))
write.csv(summary_stats, "knn_summary_statistics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r ROC}
allroc=list(GLM=LRROC,
            RF=RFROC,
            GBM=GBMROC,
            SVM=SVMROC,
            XGB=XGBROC,
            KNN=KNNROC,
            CART=CARTROC,
            MLP=MLPROC)

#计算各个模型ROC曲线下面积AUC
GLMAUC=round(auc(LRROC),3)#计算AUC值
NNETAUC=round(auc(NNETROC),3)
RFAUC=round(auc(RFROC),3)
GBMAUC=round(auc(GBMROC),3)
SVMAUC=round(auc(SVMROC),3)

XGBAUC=round(auc(XGBROC),3)
KNNAUC=round(auc(KNNROC),3)
ADAAUC=round(auc(ADAROC),3)
CARTAUC=round(auc(CARTROC),3)
MLPAUC=round(auc(MLPROC),3)

#计算AUC的95%置信区间CI
GLMCI=ci.auc(LRROC)
NNETCI=ci.auc(NNETROC)
RFCI=ci.auc(RFROC)
GBMCI=ci.auc(GBMROC)
SVMCI=ci.auc(SVMROC)

XGBCI=ci.auc(XGBROC)
KNNCI=ci.auc(KNNROC)
ADACI=ci.auc(ADAROC)
CARTCI=ci.auc(CARTROC)
MLPCI=ci.auc(MLPROC)




#ROC绘图
library(plotROC)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
pdf("Train_ROC.pdf",7,7,family = "serif")
pROC::ggroc(allroc,
            size=1,
            legacy.axes = T
)+theme_bw()+
  #geom_smooth()+
  labs(title = 'Train ROC curve')+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,size = 15,face="bold"),
    axis.text=element_text(size=12,face="bold"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size=12,face="bold"),
    legend.position=c(0.7,0.15),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=12,face="bold"),#element_blank()
    axis.title.x = element_text(size=12,face="bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color="black",size=1),
    panel.background = element_blank())+
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = 1, yend = 1),        # 绘制对角线
               colour='grey', 
               linetype = 'dotdash'
  )+
  scale_colour_discrete(
    breaks=c("GLM","SVM","GBM","NNET","RF","XGB","KNN","ADA","CART","MLP"),
    labels=c(paste0("LR(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", GLMAUC),",95%CI(",
                    sprintf("%0.3f", GLMCI[1]),"-",sprintf("%0.3f", GLMCI[3]),")"),
             paste0("SVM(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", SVMAUC),",95%CI(",
                    sprintf("%0.3f", SVMCI[1]),"-",sprintf("%0.3f", SVMCI[3]),")"),
             paste0("GBM(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", GBMAUC),",95%CI(",
                    sprintf("%0.3f", GBMCI[1]),"-",sprintf("%0.3f", GBMCI[3]),")"),
             paste0("NNET(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", NNETAUC),",95%CI(",
                    sprintf("%0.3f", NNETCI[1]),"-",sprintf("%0.3f", NNETCI[3]),")"),
             paste0("RF(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", RFAUC),",95%CI(",
                    sprintf("%0.3f", RFCI[1]),"-",sprintf("%0.3f", RFCI[3]),")"),
             paste0("XGB(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", XGBAUC),",95%CI(",
                    sprintf("%0.3f", XGBCI[1]),"-",sprintf("%0.3f", XGBCI[3]),")"),
             paste0("KNN(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", KNNAUC),",95%CI(",
                    sprintf("%0.3f", KNNCI[1]),"-",sprintf("%0.3f", KNNCI[3]),")"),
             paste0("ADA(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", ADAAUC),",95%CI(",
                    sprintf("%0.3f", ADACI[1]),"-",sprintf("%0.3f", ADACI[3]),")"),
             paste0("CART(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", CARTAUC),",95%CI(",

             paste0("MLP(AUC=",sprintf("%0.3f", MLPAUC),",95%CI(",
                    sprintf("%0.3f", MLPCI[1]),"-",sprintf("%0.3f", MLPCI[3]),")")
    ))

dev.off()
```

```{r Dev calibration curve}
dev <- testdata

table(is.na(dev))

# Predicted probabilities on the test set
LR_pro   <- predict(glm_model,  newdata = dev, type = "prob")

GBM_pro  <- predict(gbm_model,  newdata = dev, type = "prob")
SVM_pro  <- predict(svm_model,  newdata = dev, type = "prob")
XGB_pro  <- predict(xgb_model,  newdata = dev, type = "prob")
KNN_pro  <- predict(knn_model,  newdata = dev, type = "prob")
CART_pro <- predict(cartr_model,newdata = dev, type = "prob")
MLP_pro  <- predict(mlp_model,  newdata = dev, type = "prob")

# Extract positive-class probabilities
dev$LR   <- LR_pro$Yes
dev$RF   <- RF_pro$Yes
dev$GBM  <- GBM_pro$Yes
dev$SVM  <- SVM_pro$Yes
dev$XGB  <- XGB_pro$Yes
dev$KNN  <- KNN_pro$Yes
dev$CART <- CART_pro$Yes
dev$MLP  <- MLP_pro$Yes

# Calibration data
trellis.par.set(caretTheme())
cal_obj <- calibration(
  Result ~ LR  + RF + GBM + SVM + XGB + KNN  + CART + MLP,
  data = dev,
  class = "Yes",
  cuts = 10
)

caldata <- as.data.frame(cal_obj$data)
caldata <- na.omit(caldata)

# Calibration plot
ggplot(
  data = caldata,
  aes(
    x = midpoint,
    y = Percent,
    group = calibModelVar,
    color = calibModelVar
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.65) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dotdash") +
  xlim(0, 100) +
  xlab("Bin Midpoint") +
  ylab("Observed Event Percentage") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold"),

    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Model")
```

```{r Dev ROC curve}
library(pROC)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(yardstick)

model_names <- c("LR", "SVM", "GBM", "RF", "XGB", "KNN", "CART", "MLP")

roc_list <- lapply(model_names, function(model) {
  roc(response = dev$Result, predictor = dev[[model]])
})
names(roc_list) <- model_names

get_best_threshold <- function(roc_obj) {
  roc_obj$thresholds[which.max(roc_obj$sensitivities + roc_obj$specificities - 1)]
}

get_confusion_results <- function(data, outcome_col, score_col, roc_obj, positive = "Yes") {
  best_threshold <- get_best_threshold(roc_obj)
  pred_label <- factor(ifelse(data[[score_col]] > best_threshold, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  ref_label <- factor(data[[outcome_col]], levels = c("No", "Yes"))

  cm <- confusionMatrix(
    data = pred_label,
    reference = ref_label,
    positive = positive,
    mode = "everything"
  )

  cm_table <- data.frame(reference = ref_label, prediction = pred_label) %>%
    table() %>%
    as.data.frame()

  list(
    threshold = best_threshold,
    confusion_matrix = cm,
    confusion_table = cm_table
  )
}

confusion_results <- lapply(model_names, function(model) {
  get_confusion_results(
    data = dev,
    outcome_col = "Result",
    score_col = model,
    roc_obj = roc_list[[model]]
  )
})
names(confusion_results) <- model_names

plot_confusion <- function(conf_table) {
  plot_confusion_matrix(
    conf_table,
    target_col = "reference",
    prediction_col = "prediction",
    counts_col = "Freq",
    add_sums = FALSE,
    add_counts = TRUE,
    add_normalized = TRUE,
    add_row_percentages = FALSE,
    add_col_percentages = FALSE,
    diag_percentages_only = FALSE,
    rm_zero_percentages = TRUE,
    rm_zero_text = TRUE,
    add_zero_shading = TRUE,
    amount_3d_effect = 1,
    add_arrows = TRUE,
    counts_on_top = FALSE,
    palette = "Blues",
    intensity_by = "counts",
    theme_fn = ggplot2::theme_minimal,
    place_x_axis_above = TRUE,
    rotate_y_text = TRUE,
    digits = 1,
    font_counts = font(),
    font_normalized = font(),
    font_row_percentages = font(),
    font_col_percentages = font(),
    arrow_size = 0.048,
    arrow_nudge_from_text = 0.065,
    tile_border_color = NA,
    tile_border_size = 0.1,
    tile_border_linetype = "solid",
    sums_settings = sum_tile_settings(),
    darkness = 0.8
  )
}

# Example:
# plot_confusion(confusion_results[["LR"]]$confusion_table)

roc_plot_list <- list(
  GLM  = roc_list$LR,
  RF   = roc_list$RF,
  GBM  = roc_list$GBM,
  SVM  = roc_list$SVM,
  XGB  = roc_list$XGB,
  KNN  = roc_list$KNN,
  CART = roc_list$CART,
  MLP  = roc_list$MLP
)

auc_values <- sapply(roc_plot_list, function(x) round(auc(x), 3))
auc_cis <- lapply(roc_plot_list, ci.auc)

legend_labels <- c(
  paste0("LR (AUC=", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_values["GLM"]),  ", 95% CI ", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$GLM[1]),  "-", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$GLM[3]),  ")"),
  paste0("SVM (AUC=", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_values["SVM"]), ", 95% CI ", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$SVM[1]), "-", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$SVM[3]), ")"),
  paste0("GBM (AUC=", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_values["GBM"]), ", 95% CI ", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$GBM[1]), "-", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$GBM[3]), ")"),
  paste0("RF (AUC=", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_values["RF"]), ", 95% CI ", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$RF[1]), "-", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$RF[3]), ")"),
  paste0("XGB (AUC=", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_values["XGB"]), ", 95% CI ", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$XGB[1]), "-", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$XGB[3]), ")"),
  paste0("KNN (AUC=", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_values["KNN"]), ", 95% CI ", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$KNN[1]), "-", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$KNN[3]), ")"),
  paste0("CART (AUC=", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_values["CART"]), ", 95% CI ", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$CART[1]), "-", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$CART[3]), ")"),
  paste0("MLP (AUC=", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_values["MLP"]), ", 95% CI ", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$MLP[1]), "-", sprintf("%0.3f", auc_cis$MLP[3]), ")")
)

pROC::ggroc(
  roc_plot_list,
  size = 1,
  legacy.axes = TRUE
) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Test ROC curve") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = c(0.7, 0.15),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = 1, yend = 1),
    colour = "grey",
    linetype = "dotdash"
  ) +
  scale_colour_discrete(
    breaks = c("GLM", "SVM", "GBM", "RF", "XGB", "KNN", "CART", "MLP"),
    labels = legend_labels
  )
```
